title: COP17 Puts Funding and Local Voices at the Heart of Nature Action

sources.name: Convention on Biological Diversity Secretariat
sources.title: UN Biodiversity Conference charts Yerevan Pathway to accelerate global action for nature

sources.name: German Federal Environment Ministry (BMUKN)
sources.title: 17th UN Biodiversity Conference wraps up: an honest assessment – but still a steep climb ahead for international nature conservation

sources.name: IUCN
sources.title: IUCN closing statement - 17th UN Biodiversity Conference

paragraphs.en: The United Nations biodiversity conference ended
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國生物多樣性大會落幕，

paragraphs.en: in Yerevan, Armenia, on October 31, 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 時間為2026年10月31日，地點在亞美尼亞葉里溫。

paragraphs.en: Known as COP17, the meeting brought countries together
paragraphs.zh: 這場名為COP17的會議讓各國齊聚，

paragraphs.en: to review progress on global nature goals.
paragraphs.zh: 檢視全球自然保育目標的進展。

paragraphs.en: The assessment found that the world was not
paragraphs.zh: 評估發現，全球尚未

paragraphs.en: on track to reach its 2030 targets.
paragraphs.zh: 走上達成2030年目標的軌道。

paragraphs.en: Governments responded by adopting the Yerevan Pathway,
paragraphs.zh: 各國政府因而通過「葉里溫路徑」，

paragraphs.en: a shared plan to accelerate their efforts.
paragraphs.zh: 以這項共同計畫加快行動。

paragraphs.en: Its priorities reach beyond creating more protected areas.
paragraphs.zh: 其優先事項不僅是增加保護區。

paragraphs.en: The pathway connects conservation with everyday economic decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 這項路徑將保育與日常經濟決策連結。

paragraphs.en: It calls for national budgets
paragraphs.zh: 它要求各國的預算

paragraphs.en: to support the global biodiversity framework.
paragraphs.zh: 支持全球生物多樣性框架。

paragraphs.en: It also addresses subsidies and incentives
paragraphs.zh: 它也處理補貼與獎勵措施，

paragraphs.en: that encourage damage to nature.
paragraphs.zh: 這些措施可能助長對自然的破壞。

paragraphs.en: Developing countries need financial support,
paragraphs.zh: 開發中國家需要資金支援，

paragraphs.en: as well as access to science and technology.
paragraphs.zh: 也需要取得科學與技術資源。

paragraphs.en: The conference therefore treated nature protection
paragraphs.zh: 因此，大會將自然保護視為

paragraphs.en: as a responsibility across government and society,
paragraphs.zh: 政府及社會共同的責任，

paragraphs.en: rather than a task for environment departments alone.
paragraphs.zh: 而非僅由環境部門負責的工作。

paragraphs.en: Money remained a difficult subject.
paragraphs.zh: 資金仍是個棘手的議題。

paragraphs.en: Germany's environment ministry said in its October 31 statement
paragraphs.zh: 德國環境部在10月31日的聲明中表示，

paragraphs.en: that financing had been a contentious issue.
paragraphs.zh: 融資是會上備受爭議的問題。

paragraphs.en: Countries established a process for further discussions
paragraphs.zh: 各國建立了後續討論的程序，

paragraphs.en: before the next conference in 2028.
paragraphs.zh: 預計在2028年下一屆大會前進行。

paragraphs.en: The ministry described the outcome as a foundation
paragraphs.zh: 該部將成果形容為一項基礎，

paragraphs.en: for more reliable conservation funding.
paragraphs.zh: 有助於提供更穩定的保育資金。

paragraphs.en: That description leaves an important question open:
paragraphs.zh: 這樣的描述也留下了一個重要問題：

paragraphs.en: how resources will reach the places that need them.
paragraphs.zh: 資源將如何送達需要的地方。

paragraphs.en: Participation was another major part of the negotiations.
paragraphs.zh: 參與也是談判的另一項重點。

paragraphs.en: The German statement highlighted stronger roles
paragraphs.zh: 德國的聲明強調要強化

paragraphs.en: for Indigenous Peoples and local communities.
paragraphs.zh: 原住民族與地方社群的角色。

paragraphs.en: An agreement on how a new body operates
paragraphs.zh: 一項有關新機構如何運作的協議，

paragraphs.en: aims to improve their involvement in biodiversity decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 旨在提升他們參與生物多樣性決策的程度。

paragraphs.en: Their knowledge and rights were central issues.
paragraphs.zh: 他們的知識與權利都是核心議題。

paragraphs.en: This makes the conference relevant to
paragraphs.zh: 這也使大會與下列群體密切相關：

paragraphs.en: the people living in and managing natural landscapes,
paragraphs.zh: 居住於自然地景中並參與管理的人們，

paragraphs.en: not only officials negotiating international documents.
paragraphs.zh: 而不只是協商國際文件的官員。

paragraphs.en: In a statement published on November 1,
paragraphs.zh: 在11月1日發布的聲明中，

paragraphs.en: the International Union for Conservation of Nature, or IUCN,
paragraphs.zh: 世界自然保育聯盟，簡稱IUCN，

paragraphs.en: welcomed progress but emphasized remaining gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 肯定了進展，也強調仍存在的缺口。

paragraphs.en: It pointed to advances in marine conservation
paragraphs.zh: 它指出海洋保育方面已有進展，

paragraphs.en: and plans to review work on inland waters.
paragraphs.zh: 也有計畫檢討內陸水域的相關工作。

paragraphs.en: However, it warned that available resources and ambition
paragraphs.zh: 不過，它提醒，現有資源與企圖心

paragraphs.en: still did not match the scale of the challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 仍未能符合這項挑戰的規模。

paragraphs.en: Its response combined recognition of cooperation
paragraphs.zh: 其回應既肯定合作，

paragraphs.en: with concern about the practical barriers ahead.
paragraphs.zh: 也關切接下來的實際障礙。

paragraphs.en: IUCN also stressed that national reports
paragraphs.zh: IUCN也強調，各國的國家報告

paragraphs.en: had not fully captured contributions from other actors.
paragraphs.zh: 尚未完整呈現其他參與者的貢獻。

paragraphs.en: These include local governments, women, young people,
paragraphs.zh: 這些參與者包括地方政府、婦女、年輕人，

paragraphs.en: businesses, and community organizations.
paragraphs.zh: 以及企業與社區組織。

paragraphs.en: Recognizing these groups can broaden
paragraphs.zh: 認可這些群體，有助於擴大

paragraphs.en: who helps shape conservation priorities.
paragraphs.zh: 參與制定保育優先事項的人員範圍。

paragraphs.en: The implication is that global reviews
paragraphs.zh: 由此可見，全球檢討工作

paragraphs.en: need to look beyond national ministries
paragraphs.zh: 不能只看中央部會，

paragraphs.en: to understand how action is developing locally.
paragraphs.zh: 才能理解地方行動如何發展。

paragraphs.en: The next biodiversity conference will take place
paragraphs.zh: 下一屆生物多樣性大會將舉行，

paragraphs.en: in Ecuador in 2028.
paragraphs.zh: 地點是厄瓜多，時間為2028年。

paragraphs.en: Before then, governments and their partners
paragraphs.zh: 在那之前，各國政府及其夥伴

paragraphs.en: face linked questions about funding, participation, and policy.
paragraphs.zh: 將面對資金、參與及政策彼此相連的問題。

paragraphs.en: The Yerevan meeting's main message is broader
paragraphs.zh: 葉里溫會議的主要訊息更為廣泛，

paragraphs.en: than protecting isolated places on a map.
paragraphs.zh: 不只是保護地圖上一些個別地點。

paragraphs.en: Nature goals must influence how money is allocated
paragraphs.zh: 自然保育目標必須影響資金如何分配，

paragraphs.en: and whose knowledge guides decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 以及決策由誰的知識引導。

paragraphs.en: That is the challenge countries now carry home.
paragraphs.zh: 這正是各國如今帶回國內的挑戰。

across.meaning: 遍及；涵蓋多個部門或群體

actors.meaning: 參與者；文中並非指演員

areas.meaning: 區域；protected areas 指保護區

at.meaning: 在；at the heart of 指位於…的核心

been.meaning: be 的過去分詞，文中與助動詞連用構成完成式或被動語態

broader.meaning: 範圍更廣的、更大規模的

brought.meaning: 使來到一起；brought together 指讓…齊聚

calls.meaning: 呼籲、要求；calls for 指要求或倡議

carry.meaning: 帶、攜帶；carry home 指帶回國內

cop.meaning: COP17的文字部分，指《生物多樣性公約》第17次締約方大會

developing.meaning: 發展中的；developing countries 指開發中國家

did.meaning: 助動詞do的過去式，用於構成否定等句型

environment.meaning: 環境；environment ministry 指環境部

for.meaning: 為了、對於；表示用途或對象

had.meaning: 與過去分詞連用，構成過去完成式

heart.meaning: 核心；at the heart of 指處於…的核心

home.meaning: 家；文中指回到各自國內

is.meaning: 是；也可作為進行式的助動詞

it.meaning: 它；文中指路徑、機構、聲明或前述情況

its.meaning: 它的；文中指大會、機構或聲明的

iucn.meaning: 世界自然保育聯盟的英文縮寫

leaves.meaning: 留下；leave a question open 指讓問題仍待解答

look.meaning: 看；look beyond 指超越某個範圍來觀察

more.meaning: 更多；more than 指不只是

nations.meaning: 國家；United Nations 指聯合國

of.meaning: …的；連接事物與其內容、性質等關係

on.meaning: 在某日期；關於；on track 指朝向目標的正確方向

open.meaning: 未定的；leave a question open 指問題尚待解答

pathway.meaning: 路徑；文中指葉里溫路徑這項協商成果

peoples.meaning: 民族（複數）；Indigenous Peoples 指原住民族

pointed.meaning: 指出；pointed to 指指出或提及

puts.meaning: 放置；puts ... at the heart of 指將…放在核心位置

the.meaning: 定冠詞，指特定或已提過的事物

then.meaning: 那時；before then 指在那之前

to.meaning: 到、向；也用於不定詞，接動詞原形

together.meaning: 一起；taken together 指綜合來看

track.meaning: 軌道；on track to 指朝向達成某事的方向前進

union.meaning: 聯盟；International Union for Conservation of Nature 指世界自然保育聯盟

united.meaning: 聯合的；United Nations 指聯合國

voices.meaning: 聲音、意見；文中指地方群體的參與及意見

well.meaning: as well as 指也、以及

who.meaning: 誰；也可引導關係子句，指前述的人

with.meaning: 與、連同；combined ... with ... 指將…結合

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

choices.text: To compare the wildlife populations of Armenia and Ecuador.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章提到兩國是大會舉辦地，但沒有比較兩國野生動物族群。

choices.text: To explain how COP17 linked nature goals with funding, policy, and participation.
choices.explanation: 正確。第2段談經濟決策與預算，第3段談資金，第4及6段談參與，第7段將這些重點連結起來。

choices.text: To show that environment departments can achieve all nature goals alone.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第2段明確指出保育是跨政府與社會的責任，不應只交由環境部門。

choices.text: To announce that the world has already reached its 2030 targets.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第1段指出全球尚未走上達成2030年目標的軌道，並未宣告目標已達成。

quiz.explanation: 本題考主旨。文章報導COP17之後的優先事項，將自然保育與資金、經濟政策及地方參與連結。第7段是全文總結，不能把文章縮減為動物數量比較或單一部門的工作。

evidence.quote: Before then, governments and their partners face linked questions about funding, participation, and policy.
The conference therefore treated nature protection as a responsibility across government and society, rather than a task for environment departments alone.
The assessment found that the world was not on track to reach its 2030 targets.

quiz.question: What can be inferred from IUCN's comments about national reports?

choices.text: National ministries had no information about biodiversity.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第6段說的是報告未完整呈現其他參與者的貢獻，並非國家部會完全沒有資訊。

choices.text: Local contributions were fully represented in all national reports.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第6段第一句直接說明這些貢獻尚未被完整呈現。

choices.text: Only international officials can choose conservation priorities.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第4及6段都強調原住民族、地方社群及其他群體參與，而非只有國際官員能決定。

choices.text: A fuller review should include evidence from groups beyond national ministries.
choices.explanation: 正確。第6段先指出其他參與者的貢獻未被完整記錄，再推論全球檢討需要超越國家部會的範圍。

quiz.explanation: 本題考合理推論。國家報告未完整涵蓋地方政府、社群及其他群體的貢獻，意味著若要更完整了解行動進展，評估就應納入這些群體的資訊與經驗；不能推論國家報告毫無價值。

evidence.quote: IUCN also stressed that national reports had not fully captured contributions from other actors. These include local governments, women, young people, businesses, and community organizations. Recognizing these groups can broaden who helps shape conservation priorities. The implication is that global reviews need to look beyond national ministries to understand how action is developing locally.

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the next steps described in the article?

choices.text: Countries need to connect conservation with resource delivery and inclusive decisions.
choices.explanation: 正確。第3段留下資源如何送達的問題，第4段強調原住民族與地方社群參與，第7段總結資金分配與知識如何引導決策。

choices.text: The only remaining task is to choose a location for the next conference.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第7段已給出下一屆地點與時間，仍待處理的重點是資金、參與及政策。

choices.text: New protected areas remove the need for economic policy changes.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第1、2段指出優先事項不僅是增加保護區，還涵蓋預算、補貼與日常經濟決策。

choices.text: IUCN concluded that cooperation had removed every practical barrier.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第5段說IUCN肯定合作但仍關切實際障礙，並非所有問題都已消失。

quiz.explanation: 本題考整體總結。文章把後續工作分成資金如何到位、誰能參與，以及政策如何落實自然保育目標。這些工作必須一起推進，不能只靠增加保護區或舉辦下一次會議。

evidence.quote: The Yerevan meeting's main message is broader than protecting isolated places on a map. Nature goals must influence how money is allocated and whose knowledge guides decisions.
That description leaves an important question open: how resources will reach the places that need them.
Its response combined recognition of cooperation with concern about the practical barriers ahead.
